tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Present: must = I'm sure it's true; might / may / could = it's possible; can't = I'm sure it's not true (The sheriff might know more). Past: must have / might have / can't have + past participle (She must have bought it in Sacramento; he can't have done it). Use couldn't have as well as can't have; never use mustn't for deduction.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Лісабон довго дивиться на тебе, потім киває: «Офіціантка. Тихо». Але коли ви підходите до стійки, офіціантки вже немає. На прилавку лежить її фартух — і записка з однією адресою на узбережжі.
end_good.text_pl: Lisbon długo na ciebie patrzy, potem kiwa głową: „Kelnerka. Po cichu”. Ale kiedy podchodzicie do lady, kelnerki już nie ma. Na ladzie leży jej fartuch — i kartka z jednym adresem na wybrzeżu.
end_good.text_en: Lisbon looks at you for a long time, then nods: “The waitress. Quietly.” But when you reach the counter, the waitress is gone. Her apron lies on the counter, with a note bearing a single address on the coast.
